invariants_acknowledged: User mail is sent only from the user mailbox or an admin-enabled tenant mailbox; never the platform provider and never the mock (owner Q6/Q7, ADR-085)
An email is recorded SENT only after the transport accepted it; a failed send is FAILED with a coded reason and is never retried through another mailbox or provider (Q4)
SMTP/IMAP passwords, OAuth refresh tokens and PKCE verifiers are written only through requireEncryptionKey + ENCRYPTED_FIELDS and are never returned, logged or audited (CA-2/CA-3)
Tenant-supplied SMTP/IMAP hosts connect only to the DNS-resolved public address that was checked, on ports 465/587/2525 (SMTP) or 993 (IMAP), with TLS required

A bounce report suppresses an address only if it matches a record sent from the same mailbox and tenant within 30 days by both the record header and the original Message-ID, and names one of its recipients (CA-18)
Suppressed recipients are dropped before quota is reserved; all suppressed sends nothing (Q9)
Every tenant-scoped mutation filters by tenantId and has a cross-tenant negative test; a user can never act on another user mailbox or signature

Module-settings playbook: PageHeader/ModuleSettingsShell, bento grid, canonical EmptyState phase=passive, $transaction on destructive writes, no skipDuplicates, superRefine on duplicate signature names; TagsTab and colorToken are N/A
No istanbul/v8 ignore pragmas; full package suites through the slot wrapper; Node 22 for DB writes; no secret-shaped fixtures
